MATCH (o:Owner)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT o,
  CAST(SPLIT(o.birth_date, '/')[0] AS INT64) AS birth_year,
  CAST(SPLIT(o.birth_date, '/')[1] AS INT64) AS birth_month,
  CAST(SPLIT(o.birth_date, '/')[2] AS INT64) AS birth_day
WITH o,
  2026 - birth_year - CASE WHEN birth_month > 10 OR (birth_month = 10 AND birth_day > 14) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
WHERE (age >= 65 AND age = 65)
   OR EXISTS {
     MATCH (o)-[:Owns]->(t:Team)
     WHERE t.team_name <> 'Indiana Pacers' AND t.team_name <> 'New Orleans Pelicans'
   }
RETURN DISTINCT o.nationality AS col1, age AS col2, o.name AS col3, o.name AS name_manager

MATCH (o:Owner)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT o, STRING_SPLIT(o.birth_date, '/') AS slash_parts, STRING_SPLIT(o.birth_date, ' ') AS word_parts
WITH o,
  CASE WHEN o.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN CAST(slash_parts[1] AS INT64) ELSE CAST(word_parts[2] AS INT64) END AS birth_year,
  CASE WHEN o.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN CAST(slash_parts[2] AS INT64) ELSE CASE word_parts[1]
    WHEN 'January' THEN 1 WHEN 'February' THEN 2 WHEN 'March' THEN 3 WHEN 'April' THEN 4
    WHEN 'May' THEN 5 WHEN 'June' THEN 6 WHEN 'July' THEN 7 WHEN 'August' THEN 8
    WHEN 'September' THEN 9 WHEN 'October' THEN 10 WHEN 'November' THEN 11 WHEN 'December' THEN 12
  END END AS birth_month,
  CASE WHEN o.birth_date CONTAINS '/' THEN CAST(slash_parts[3] AS INT64) ELSE 1 END AS birth_day
WITH o, 2026 - birth_year - CASE
  WHEN birth_month > 10 OR (birth_month = 10 AND birth_day > 14) THEN 1 ELSE 0
END AS age
WHERE (age >= 65 AND age = 65)
   OR EXISTS {
     MATCH (o)-[:Owns]->(t:Team)
     WHERE t.team_name <> 'Indiana Pacers' AND t.team_name <> 'New Orleans Pelicans'
   }
RETURN DISTINCT o.nationality AS col1, age AS col2, o.name AS col3, o.name AS name_manager
